# hermes-lcm-ledger v0.1.0-rc.2

This candidate builds on the Ledger fork of Hermes-LCM by Stephen Schoettler and contributors, including the changes originally proposed in upstream PR #589.

Long sessions can recover all summary depths, and a committed leaf carries its restart checkpoint in the same SQLite transaction. Ledger opens the existing `lcm.db` in place. Concurrent rotations preserve the rolling backup, and ordinary ingestion can continue during a file-backed snapshot.

Full-text recall decodes fewer candidate messages and returns verifiable source offsets. Hermes can keep the static recall policy in its session prompt. Desktop shows the focused chat’s loaded settings alongside the profile settings when its engine is reachable.
